explanation: The theorem gives the cardinality of `cIco`, a cyclic half-open interval on `Fin n` defined in this library. I grepped Mathlib for `cIco` and related cyclic-interval names. The only hit in `Mathlib/Order/Circular.lean` is a docstring remark that `cIco` and `cIoc` are not defined there. I found no Mathlib declaration for the cardinality of a cyclic interval in `Fin n`. The proof uses `Fin.card_Ico`, `Fin.card_Ici` and `Fin.card_Iio`, which only cover non-wrapping intervals.
